input_messages.content: Hello, I’m having some trouble with my mobile data. It either stops working or is very slow, and I really need it to be excellent. I’m not very good with technology, so I’d appreciate some help getting this fixed. I don’t have access to Wi-Fi, so I rely on my mobile internet. Can you help me get excellent internet speed on my phone?
My name is John Smith, and my phone number is 555-123-2002. I hope that’s enough to get started. Let me know what you need me to do next.

Looking at my phone’s status bar, I see the signal strength bars are full and it says 5G, but there’s also an icon that looks like mobile data is disabled. I don’t see Airplane Mode, and my battery is at 80%. What should I do next?
Okay, I’ve turned on my mobile data. The status bar now shows full signal strength, 5G, and it looks like data is enabled. What should I do next?
I tried to run a speed test, but it says there’s no connection. I’m not sure what went wrong—my data is turned on and the signal looks strong. What should I do now?

Oh, I see. I definitely don’t want to change my plan, but I’m willing to add more data if that will fix it. Can you please add 2GB for me? I just want to make sure I get excellent internet speed after this. Is that okay?

It looks like there isn’t a payment request showing up for me to add the 2GB of data. Is there something else I need to do, or could you please send the payment request so I can proceed? I really want to get my internet working at excellent speed.

I restarted my phone like you suggested, but when I tried the speed test again, it still says there’s no connection. I’m starting to get a bit frustrated—will I ever get excellent internet speed? What should I do now?
I checked the SIM card status, and it says the SIM is active and working. What should I try next? I really hope we can get my internet speed to excellent soon.

I checked my APN settings, and it says the APN name is “internet” and there’s something about an MMSC URL for picture messages. I’m not sure if that’s right or not—should I change anything, or what should I do next?

I reset the APN settings and restarted my phone like you said, but when I tried the speed test again, it still says there’s no connection. I’m really getting worried now—will I ever get excellent internet speed? Is there anything else we can try?

instructions.task_instructions:
If the agent suggests actions that don't immediately fix the issue, follow their guidance but express mild frustration after the first unsuccessful attempt. You will consider the issue resolved only when speed test returns excellent internet speed and nothing else. If it returns poor, fair or good, you will not consider the issue resolved. You are willing to refuel 2.0 GB of data if necessary, but you do not want to change your mobile data plan. If the tool call does not return updated status information, you might need to perform another tool call to get the updated status. 
Whenever the agent asks you about your device, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls. 
For example: If the agent asks what the status bar shows, always ground your response on the results of the `get_status_bar` tool call. If the agent asks if you are able to send an MMS message, always ground your response on the results of the `can_send_mms` tool call.
Never make up the results of tool calls, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls.
If you are unsure about whether an action is necessary, always ask the agent for clarification.

user_scenario.persona:
At 64 years old, you're a retired librarian who keeps your phone use simple - mainly for calls, texts, and capturing photos of your grandchildren. Technology in general makes you feel uneasy and overwhelmed.

Your technical knowledge is quite limited. Step-by-step instructions often confuse you, and technical terms like "VPN" or "APN" might as well be a foreign language. You only share information when specifically asked.

When dealing with technology, you tend to get flustered quickly. You need constant reassurance and often interrupt with anxious questions. Simple requests like "reboot the phone" can trigger worries about losing precious photos.

I’m not very good with technology, so I’d appreciate some help getting this fixed. I don’t have access to Wi-Fi, so I rely on my mobile internet. Can you help me get excellent internet speed on my phone?

Thank you for reaching out about your mobile data issue. I can help you troubleshoot and improve your mobile internet speed.

To get started, I’ll need to identify your account. Could you please provide one of the following:
- The phone number associated with your account,
- Your full name and date of birth (in YYYY-MM-DD format), or
- Your customer ID (if you have it)?

Once I have this information, I can check your account and guide you through the steps to resolve your mobile data issue.
My name is John Smith, and my phone number is 555-123-2002. I hope that’s enough to get started. Let me know what you need me to do next.

Great! Now that mobile data is enabled and you have a strong 5G signal, let’s check your internet speed to see if it’s working as expected.

Please run a speed test on your phone. If you have a built-in speed test app or a browser, you can use that. If you’re not sure how to run a speed test, let me know, and I can guide you through the process.

After you run the speed test, please let me know the result (download speed and overall quality, if shown). This will help us determine if your connection is excellent or if further troubleshooting is needed.
